name: Nutrimix 7+ Strawberry Nutrition Powder (350g)
subtitle: The ultimate ragi & bajra blend for your older kids!

ingredients.name: Ragi Millets
ingredients.shortDesc: Our paediatricians say: Ragi is a household name in India. Known for its high calcium and protein content, ragi is the perfect grain to mix into your kid's foods for maximum health.

ingredients.name: Almond Powder
ingredients.shortDesc: Our paediatricians say: Almonds are one of the best plant-based protein sources out there. Packed with nutrients, almonds are rich in Vitamin E, magnesium and essential fatty acids, keeping you happy and healthy.

ingredients.name: Jaggery
ingredients.shortDesc: Our paediatricians say: Jaggery, commonly known as gur in Hindi, is one of the best natural sweeteners. It helps in regulation of body temperature and detoxifies the body. It also prevents constipation and improves digestion.

ingredients.name: Walnut Powder
ingredients.shortDesc: Our paediatricians say: You may think we’re nuts for suggesting this but walnuts actually have incredibly high nutritional content. Filled with omega-3 fatty acids, walnuts help boost memory, concentration and overall cognitive behaviour.

ingredients.name: Oats Fiber
ingredients.shortDesc: Our paediatricians say: The prevalence of childhood constipation can be as high as 29.6%. Studies indicate that oat bran, the fiber-rich outer layer of the grain, may help relieve constipation and may reduce the use of laxatives. It also promotes healthy gut bacteria and naturally slows digestion - increasing feelings of fullness.

ingredients.name: Moong Dal Protein
ingredients.shortDesc:
Found in: Moong Dal

Our pediatricians say: Moong dal is considered to be one of the best plant-based sources of protein and can do wonders for your kid's hair, skin and nails. The folate in moong dal boosts bone marrow and brain function.

ingredients.name: Brown Rice Protein
ingredients.shortDesc:
Found in: Brown Rice

Our pediatricians say: The complex carbohydrates in brown rice promote feelings of satiation, keeping kids’ tummies full and happy. Brown rice contains a whole host of micronutrients that are useful in helping kids’ body and brain develop.

ingredients.name: Pea Protein
ingredients.shortDesc:
Found in: Pea

Our pediatricians say: The peas that your kids are constantly trying to avoid? They’re actually complete sources of protein so the more peas your kids eat, the hap-pea-er they’ll be!

ingredients.name: Chia Seeds
ingredients.shortDesc: Our paediatricians say: Just like your little ones, chia seeds are tiny but packed with energy. Loaded with omega-3 fatty acids (those again), fiber, antioxidants, iron, and calcium, these tiny seeds only need to be soaked in water for 10 minutes for full impact!

ingredients.name: Flax Seeds
ingredients.shortDesc: Our paediatricians say: Unless you’re a fish, your body can’t make omega-3. No problem. Flax seed is one of the richest vegan sources of essential omega-3. This fatty acid not only acts as an antioxidant to prevent disease, but it is used by the body to promote brain function.

ingredients.name: Vitamin D3
ingredients.shortDesc:
Found in: Fish, mushrooms, cheese, egg yolks etc.

Form: Cholecalciferol (vegetarian source lichen)

Amount: 600 IU

 Our paediatricians say: Vitamin D3 is a very underrated mineral for growing children. Your kids may grow out of their clothes, but they’ll never grow out of good old natural minerals. For parents with picky children - slip our supplements into their chocolate milk, they’ll never know!

ingredients.name: Calcium
ingredients.shortDesc:
Found in: Broccoli, Collard greens, Kale

Form: Calcium hydrogen phosphate/Tricalcium phosphate

Our paediatricians say: Calcium has been shown to support bones and development. Kids don't naturally produce calcium, and most kids do not get the calcium they need from foods alone, often causing their bodies to start “borrowing” calcium from their bones...eeeek, which makes bones fragile. Our product supplies approx. 32% of Calcium RDA per serving.

ingredients.name: Vegan Algal DHA
ingredients.shortDesc:
Found in: Flaxseed, Algae

Form: Docosahexaenoic Acid (DHA)

Amount: 100 mg

Our paediatricians say: If there was a nutritional hero,it would be DHA. DHA is vital to the structure of the brain and may improve learning, memory, immunity and inflammation. Vegetarian kids are especially deficient in DHA. Our supplement is vegan and is sourced from flaxseed.

ingredients.name: Vitamin B12
ingredients.shortDesc:
Found in: Fish, meats, milk, egg yolk etc.

Form: Cyanocobalamin

Amount: 2.2 mcg

Our paediatricians says: Vitamin B12 is our supermineral. It turns food into energy, which in turn fuels brain development. Most natural B12 is found in animal sources and this is especially good for vegetarians and vegans! As a supermineral, we supply 100% of the recommended serving.

ingredients.name: Vitamin K1
ingredients.shortDesc:
Found in: Green leafy vegetables, Broccoli, etc

Form: Phylloquinone

Our paediatricians say:K1 is essential for bone development, and bones develop the most in childhood and teen years—especially during the adolescent spurt when teens fill out in the chest, shoulders and hips. Calcium, vitamins K1 and D3 represent ‘The Bone Health Triangle’. Our product supplies approx. 50% of Vitamin K1 RDA per serving.

fullIngredientsList: Protein Blend (Skim Milk Powder, Milk Protein Concentrate, Milk Permeate Powder, Almonds Powder, Walnut Powder, Pea Protein Isolate & Moong Dal Protein), Sweetener Blend (Jaggery Powder & Dates Powder), Beetroot Powder, Fiber Blend (Fructooligosaccharides, Oats Fiber, Chia Seeds, Flax Seeds, Ragi Powder & Bajra Powder), Nature Identical Flavour (Strawberry), Algal DHA (Docosahexaenoic Acid), Digezyme® (α-amylase, Protease, Lipase, Cellulase and Lactase), Stabilizer (Xanthan Gum), Minerals (Calcium (Tribasic Calcium Phosphate), Phosphorous (Potassium Phosphate), Potassium (Potassium Phosphate), Sodium (Sodium Chloride), Magnesium (Magnesium Oxide), Zinc (Zinc Sulphate), Manganese (Manganese Sulphate), Iodine (Potassium Iodate), Selenium (Sodium Selenate), Chromium (Chromium Chloride)), Vitamins (Vitamin C (Ascorbic Acid), Vitamin E (D-alpha Tocopheryl Acetate), Vitamin B3 (Nicotinamide), Vitamin B5 (Calcium D-Pantothenate), Vitamin B6 (Pyridoxine HCl), Vitamin B2 (Riboflavin), Vitamin B1 (Thiamine HCl), Vitamin A (Retinyl Palmitate), Vitamin B9 (Folic Acid), Vitamin K2-7 (Menaquinone-7), Biotin (D-Biotin), Vitamin D3 (Cholecalciferol -Veg Lichen), Vitamin B12 (Cyanocobalamin).

description:
The most nutrient packed milk mix in India for overall health & development, made especially to fill nutritional gaps in kids aged 7-12 years.

Fills more than 40% of kids' daily protein requirement with 1 glass of milk. 

Zero preservative & refined sugar (like Maltodextrin). Naturally sweetened with dates & jaggery.

Contains 5x more Vitamin D3 to help absorb more nutrients from milk.

Made with natural superfoods like Ragi, Bajra, Almonds, & Walnuts.

Formulated by nutritionists & pediatricians.

For 7 years and older, mix 2 scoops (30 grams) of the nutrition powder with 200 ml milk. Then shake things up!

Note: This is meant for immediate consumption and should be had in hot or cold milk!

"My daughter loves her new nutrition powder! She's very active and plays many sports so this is the perfect booster for her every morning. She wakes up only to drink it!! As a parent, I'm just thrilled that this has ingredients like ragi, bajra and jaggery that she wouldn't eat otherwise!"

faqs.question: What age range is the Little Joys Nutrimix 7+ suitable for?
faqs.answer: Nutrimix 7+ is suitable for every child of age 7 years & above.

faqs.question: Can I replace my child's meal with Nutrimix 7+?
faqs.answer: We suggest using Nutrimix 7+ as a supplement to a well-balanced diet. Nutrimix 7+ is not a replacement for a meal for children.

faqs.question: Can I book a Nutritionist Consultation for my child on Little Joys?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can book an appointment with our expert nutritionist from home page. Our panel of 30+ nutritionists has helped 50k+ parents find a solution to their child’s immunity & nutritional intake concerns.

faqs.question: How to prepare 1 serving of Nutrimix 7+?
faqs.answer: Mix 2 scoops (30 grams) of the nutrition powder with 200 ml milk or water to prepare 1 serving of Nutrimix 7+.

faqs.question: My kids eat a well-balanced diet. Do they still require Nutrimix 7+?
faqs.answer: Children often are picky about their eating habits and providing them with their daily nutritional requirements can become a task. Therefore, for supplementing their diet, Nutrimix 7+ is an excellent choice.

faqs.question: Nutrimix 7+ is available in which flavour?
faqs.answer: Nutrimix 7+ is currently available in chocolate, Strawberry, Vanilla and many more.

faqs.question: Is the Nutrimix 7+ allergen free?
faqs.answer: Nutrimix 7+ has been made by our team of doctors specifically keeping the dietary requirements of children in mind. It is free of eggs, shellfish, soy, gluten, wheat, fish allergens, peanuts and tree nut allergens (brazil, cashew, coconut, hazelnut, pecan, pistachio, macadamia). Nutrimix 7+ is also free of any synthetic colors, artificial flavors or sweeteners and is Non-GMO and gluten-free. All in all, we can say Nutrimix 7+ is very safe for consumption.However, Nutrimix 7+ does contain milk, pea, almonds, walnuts as allergens and we recommend checking with your pediatrician if your child is allergic to the same.

faqs.question: When should I give my child Nutrimix 7+?
faqs.answer: Nutrimix 7+ Health Drink should be used alongside or in-between meals, as part of a healthy, balanced diet.

faqs.question: Do doctors recommend taking Nutrimix 7+?
faqs.answer: Nutrimix 7+ has been formulated by expert pediatricians and has the seal of approval of doctors.
